title: Common-degree twists are invertible on a quasi-compact Proj open
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj], and let $U\subseteq P$ be a quasi-compact open subscheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [def-weil-open-immersion]. Suppose homogeneous elements $f_1,\ldots,f_r$ of positive degrees cover $U$ by $U\subseteq\bigcup_iD_+(f_i)$. If $e\geq1$ is a common multiple of their degrees, let $W_e$ be the largest open subscheme of $P$ on which every $\mathcal O_P(ne)$ is invertible and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O_P(ne)\otimes\mathcal O_P(me)\to\mathcal O_P((n+m)e)$ are isomorphisms (equivalently, the union of standard opens $D_+(ab)$ with homogeneous $a,b$ and $\deg(a)=\deg(b)+e$). Then $U\subseteq W_e$; consequently, for every $k\geq1$, the restricted twist $\mathcal O_U(ek)=\mathcal O_P(ek)|_U$ is invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], and the canonical multiplication map $\mathcal O_U(e)^{\otimes k}\to\mathcal O_U(ek)$ is an isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].
